verdict.rationale: Reliability analytics is a fair question for an incident-management and on-call platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of MTTA/MTTR trend dashboards, incident-load reporting or on-call health metrics. A community remark that "metrics looked worse" after adoption does not establish that Rootly itself ships analytics. API and MCP incident queries are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such reporting, so they earn no credit.
